title: Fitting Room Note: Allowance for Adjustments Agreed at Extra Fittings (Marlowe & Finch Alterations)
content:
Adjustments agreed with the tailor at extra fittings can add to the work on a Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket. A fitting allowance is added to the honored amount for adjustments agreed at extra fittings:

| Extra fitting fee charges on the ticket | Fitting allowance added to the honored amount |
|---|---|
| two or more | 10.00 USD |
| one | 5.00 USD |
| none | none |

**What is counted.** The extra fitting fee charges booked on the ticket, each counting once whatever its amount. Fittings included in the price of the ticket carry no extra fitting fee charge and are not counted.

## Both sides of each step

| Extra fitting fee charges | Allowance |
|---|---|
| 0 | none |
| 1 | 5.00 USD |
| 2 | 10.00 USD |
| 3 | 10.00 USD |

## Hypothetical illustration

A Bridal Alterations ticket whose price includes three fittings has had five fittings, two of them charged as extra fittings: the honored amount is raised by 10.00 USD.
